# music.vaked.dev

> An intergalactic cogito-ergo-sum TV — a self-generating constellation that
> broadcasts its own music. Three.js particle sphere + procedural Web Audio.
> No samples, no assets, no backend.

Source: https://github.com/peterlodri-sec/music.vaked.dev

## What it is

- A Three.js particle sphere that spreads into a constellation with the music's
  energy (SPREAD SPHERE ALL), breathing at an idle baseline even when silent.
- A procedural Web Audio engine (INTO LOVE) — love-diatonic pads, melody, bass,
  generated live from a seeded voice. 0 + 1: an LFO and an analyser agree on the
  energy that drives the sphere.
- Single-file static site, zero build step, no dependencies beyond the pinned
  Three.js CDN build.

## Sibling ecosystem

- art.vaked.dev — generative gallery
- ENTHEA — visual synthesizer (formerly on this domain; still at entheai.pages.dev)
- loop-radio — procedural Web Audio engine (AGPL-3.0)
